component.name: Crosspoint
component.summary: Audio mixer with routing matrix on PipeWire

description.p: Crosspoint is an audio mixer for Linux. Eight input strips are routed to eight buses through a crosspoint matrix, with per-strip EQ, compressor, gate and denoiser, per-bus limiter, multi-band limiting, recording and VBAN streaming over the local network.
Devices and routing are handled by PipeWire; the mixer runs as a JACK client, so any PipeWire or JACK application can feed and record it.
